chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ali ibn Ibrahim al-Ja'fari, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, raising it from them (peace be upon him)
They said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), whenever he ate, would feed the one in front of his eyes, and whenever he drank, he would give drink to the one on his right.

key_terms.بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ: in front of his eyes (directly before him)

ai.seo_question: What was the Prophet's etiquette when eating and drinking according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith illustrates the Prophet’s (peace be upon him) meticulous adherence to social etiquette (adab) during dining, reflecting the Shia emphasis on emulating his practical conduct. The specific act of feeding the person in front and serving the one on the right underscores a hierarchy of generosity and attentiveness to companions, reinforcing the spiritual value of communal dining in Islamic tradition.
